  <article class="resource-compact" id="r4ds"><h3>R for Data Science, 2nd edition</h3><p>Hadley Wickham, Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel and Garrett Grolemund.   <div class="reading-map">
  <article><h3>Module 01</h3><p><a href="#r4ds">R4DS</a> to situate the workflow and <a href="#quarto-docs">Quarto</a> to understand the HTML report.</p></article>

  <article><h3>Module 03</h3><p><a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/strings.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">R4DS Strings</a> and recoding references for categorical variables.</p></article>

  <article><h3>Module 05</h3><p><a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/EDA.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">EDA</a>, <a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/datetimes.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">dates</a> and <a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/data-tidy.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">tidy data</a>.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Module 06</h3><p><a href="#github-docs">GitHub Docs</a>, <a href="https://quarto.org/docs/computations/inline-code.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Quarto Inline Code</a> and <a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/joins.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">R4DS Joins</a>.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Module 07</h3><p><a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/communication.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">R4DS Communication</a> to move from graph to understandable message.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Module 08</h3><p><a href="https://r4ds.hadley.nz/webscraping.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener">R4DS Web scraping</a> to understand HTML, CSS and extraction.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Module 09</h3><p>Targeted review of prediction, validation and bias concepts in the module material.</p></article>
  <article><h3>Module 10</h3><p><a href="#tidytext">Text Mining with R</a>, chapters 1 to 3, then <a href="https://rstudio.github.io/flexdashboard/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">flexdashboard</a> and <a href="https://shiny.posit.co/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Shiny</a> documentation.</p></article>
